reconcile.note: John Gill restricts Joshua 24:19's refusal to forgive to obstinate idolaters and the self-righteous, while affirming God pardons all who seek him and confess.

sides.snippet: he will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins
sides.verseText: Joshua said to the people, You can't serve Yahweh; for he is a holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.

sides.snippet: he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins
sides.verseText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
